input_scope: name/address/source alias/code/typing state only; no conversational request wrapper
omission: drop only known generic chunks, or street type prefix; compatible recalculated from remaining tokens
reorder: move a whole generic type chunk; or street vs housenumber; not random word permutation
numeric_policy: never manufacture or corrupt house/unit/code digits; preserve slash in address variants
bilingual: source label and source alias only; no machine-invented translation
ime: existing raw synthetic keystreams retained, not real keyboard composition; screenshot mixed Telex is not claimed verified
source_v3: original evaluated test preserved separately, active test is a revised cohort
expansion_balance: 20 families x 500; poi_input_variants replaces sentence templates; subtype counts need not be equal
holdout: new families remain separate, synthetic generator revised before new model evaluation
final_input_policy: POI input, address, source aliases, code, typing errors/prefix; no chat request templates
final_review_pass: apply_ai_review.py with explicit manual_review_choices.json; required after proposal generation
generic_chunks: proposal generator is followed by individual Codex corrections; do not use intermediate candidates as final dataset
immutable_comparison: frozen_v3_test.parquet is the original v3 Parquet byte for byte
dataset_row_identity: Use dataset_version plus query_id; source_query_id/source_dataset_version preserve ancestry
